implementation.globalEnvironment: No caller frame or dependency substitute object enters environment chain. C++ helper compiles in current Realm; private control admits an actual checked global and enters its Realm.
implementation.ownership: Engine owns compiled function/source. Original source object can die, closures retain live passed objects and source values, no strong native function cache is added.
implementation.errors: Actual parser SyntaxErrors/pending exception; actual foreign syntax-error prototype/caller restoration and thrown-value identity; private protocol type errors do not coerce inputs.
implementation.scheduling: Compiler does not execute body or add event-loop references. Actual compiled code creates ordinary Promise/await jobs handled by existing engine loop; full async-resource/Promise lifecycle integration remains separate.
